title: Keyturn Roadside Assistance: Acceptance of a Vehicle onto a Plan
content:
## Conditions of acceptance

A vehicle is accepted onto a Keyturn Roadside Assistance plan only where it is no older than the
plan's age limit, counted in whole years from the model year, and only where its listing sits in one of
the plan's eligible value classes.

A plan whose electric vehicle cover is the point of it is written only on a vehicle recorded as battery
electric, and a combustion vehicle on such a plan is moved to the plan that fits rather than left with
cover it cannot use.

### The conditions taken one at a time

| Condition | What satisfies it | What does not |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Age | A vehicle whose whole years from the model year are no more than the plan's age limit | A vehicle older in whole years than that limit |
| Listing class | A vehicle whose Keyturn Vehicle Listing sits in one of the value classes the plan carries | A vehicle whose listing sits in a class the plan does not carry |
| Fuel, on a plan written around electric vehicle cover | A vehicle recorded as battery electric | A combustion vehicle, which is moved to the plan that fits |

Both the age condition and the listing-class condition must be satisfied for the vehicle to be
accepted; each is stated as an "only where", so failing either is enough to keep the vehicle off the
plan.

### Boundary of the age condition

The limit is expressed as "no older than", so a vehicle whose whole years from the model year come to
exactly the plan's age limit is within it and may be accepted. A vehicle one whole year older than the
limit is outside it. The count runs in whole years from the model year, not from the date the vehicle
was bought or first listed.
